Experience a lifestyle that keeps you close to Pune’s key destinations, thriving business hubs, educational institutions, and everyday essentials. Live where every destination feels closer and every day feels more connected.

A home is never just about walls and windows. It's about the trust behind every promise and the moments that begin with a simple handover of keys.
For over 35 years, Kolte Patil has been creating spaces where dreams find an address and families build their future.
Every key handed over carries a promise.
A promise of quality, commitment, and trust.

Good design is also knowing what not to build.
Keeping certain areas open, allowing for air and light to do their job and letting the home feel less contained. We always let nature do the talking, so that none of our spaces feel imposing, but almost like an extension of the environment.​

1991 → Today. One foundation. One promise.
For over three decades, every brick laid, every structure raised, and every community shaped has reflected the trust our customers place in us.
What began in 1991 continues today with the same commitment to quality, integrity, and craftsmanship because great construction is built on more than concrete and steel. It’s built on relationships that stand the test of time.
Thank you for being part of our journey. Here's to building the future, together.

Once the intent is clear, design begins its work.
Proportion, light and details slowly bring the idea to life. Rooms begin to feel purposeful and spaces invite people to pause, meet or just be. The presence of
good design is experienced in the ease of living.​
​

In the discipline of a blueprint lies the decision about how people will live within a space. It is where intention takes its first form and where imagination becomes something tangible enough to build upon.​

There is a particular clarity to a home before it is lived in. No voices yet, no furniture to define its character, only proportion, air and sunlight setting the tone. It is an invitation and a suggestion of mornings to come and fond memories yet to be made.​
​

For a child, home is the first world they explore. Every room is an invitation to imagine. A sofa becomes a mountain, a hallway a racetrack and a window seat a place to dream. Within these familiar walls, curiosity finds the freedom to wander.​
​

It is in the small habits of daily life that a home truly comes alive. Over time, these little moments begin to matter most. It is within these simple patterns that the most enduring memories begin to form.​
​
